summary: A PowerShell-to-WSL stdin retry contaminated the intended --dry-run argument with CR. The legacy permissive argument parser treated the unknown argument as publish mode, created one commit in the gitignored temporary wiki clone, and attempted a push. The push exited nonzero and the remote ref did not change.

events.effect: stopped before clone, commit, or push

read_only_containment_evidence.reason: The fresh clone and independent ls-remote agree on 91734b6; neither equals temporary local commit 4506900.

root_causes: wiki-sync.sh did not translate a native-Windows linked-worktree gitdir pointer when run inside WSL.
wiki-sync.sh accepted every argument other than exact --dry-run as implicit publish mode instead of failing closed.
The stdin wrapper transport introduced CR into the intended dry-run argument.
corrective_actions: Reject CR-suffixed, unknown, and multiple arguments before any Git command; accept only zero arguments or exact --dry-run.
Resolve linked-worktree .git pointers and translate drive-letter gitdirs under WSL before umbrella Git queries.
Run offline tests with a local bare wiki remote and Git invocation log proving exact dry-run contains no commit or push.
Remove the verified gitignored .wiki-tmp clone after preserving this evidence, then rerun the native WSL dry-run without a wrapper.

post_fix_verification.invocation: wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 bash -lc cd <worktree> && bash scripts/wiki-sync.sh --dry-run
